# 📢 Announcing: Round Robin StoryBot v2.0
### April 2026
## 💫  New Features
### 🌟 Major Additions:
> * **Metadata:** Stories now have full metadata fields available: Rating, Warnings, Dynamic, Main Pairing, Other Pairings, Characters, Tags
> * **Collaborative Tagging**: writers can submit their own suggestions for tagging a work. Admins or story creators can review and approve/reject submissions.
> * **Restricted Feed Channel**: Stories with mature or explicit ratings can be filtered to a separate channel (set in `/storyadmin setup`)  that can be age-restricted by the server admin.
> * **Weekly Roundup**: The bot can post a weekly summary to your story feed (or other channel of your choice). Each roundup shows active stories, stats (stories created/completed, turns submitted/missed, words written), and a list of writers who contributed that week. Writers earn badges based on their all-time entry count, with a special first-timer badge for anyone who submits their very first entry. You can choose the hour and day of the week that you'd like the roundup to post to the channel of your choice (or leave the channel blank to disable) in `/storyadmin setup`

### ✨ Minor Additions:
> * **Autocomplete** now tries to fill in on all story commands that take a story ID, turn number, or username. It's a little slow to load, and sometimes errors out, but you can always just type the value if you know it. Results should be filtered to what's relevant for each command (e.g. /mystory pass only shows stories where it's currently your turn).
> * **Reassign**: New admin command that gives the turn back to the previous writer immediately, then queues the writer who was skipped to go next, so the rotation resumes in order. Useful when a turn timed out and the previous writer still wants to contribute.
> * **`/story timeleft` and Request More Time**: Writers can check who has the current turn, and how much time is remaining, and the result will load with a button that allows them to request an extension.
> * **Repost After Editing** — After editing an entry through the read interface, a Repost button appears so you can immediately push the updated version to the story feed.

## 🛠️ Improvements
> * **Management Control Panels**: `/mystory manage` (story membership management) and `/storyadmin manage` (writer management) — Simplified the interface for updating user and story settings: pen name, turn notification preference (DM or @mention), and turn thread privacy (public or private), and simplified the command for admins to manage both stories and users. Admins can select a story or story and user to view current settings and take actions — change configuration, pause, unpause, or remove a user from the story — all from one interface with confirmation prompts.
> * **Image Display**: Story images now appear in `/story read` as an embed grid when reading the story, with inline references still in the text.
> * **Long Entry Support** — entries over 4,000 characters, and super long entries over 6,000, now post as multiple messages, paging correctly when posted, read, and edited
